scope: shared factory workflow; no generated-game workspace selected

reproduction.input: User wants a straightforward reference-game recreation and reports that the factory has many stages whose value is unclear and that generated results are often unsatisfactory.
evidence: fast-reskin currently plans 36 mandatory stages for reference_reskin runs
ReferenceMechanicSpec permits source.researchFiles to be empty, so a reference URL can exist without bound gameplay evidence
Existing automated tests validate factory behavior but do not establish reference-to-build fidelity

hypotheses.cause: The fast lane optimizes governance and release evidence rather than perceptual and mechanical similarity.
The builder receives a human mechanic summary but not a required, verified reference behavior trace or media set.
There is no explicit fidelity gate that compares input/state transitions, failure pressure, feedback timing, and recovery against the reference.

acceptanceCriteria: A reference preview run exposes no more than eight user-visible gates.
Every gate states its purpose, input, output, and evidence in plain language.
The builder receives verified reference behavior evidence, not only a URL and prose summary.
The preview cannot pass unless core-loop order, action/state branches, failure/recovery, and feedback timing are covered.
Full platform, compliance, and release checks remain available as a separate release path.
